author: StraightG0lden
body:
Currently the Cupid follower from the event is worth farming, it's an upgrade from the Fey Cactus and probably better than Selene for most things (Selene has more skills so she's going to be less consistent).

After the follower Lyncus Paws and Blackened Eyes of Kerberos are the only current event things that would be worth farming for Beo, some builds do use them. You could also work on a Celestial Lute for some different Beo setups, I have one for a Towerfall build because I had bad luck with the Epee's and another one for a Verse build that I use in endless as a hydrus as things you could work towards. Two questing weapons for your Orn set if you can survive without the shield is something you could do if you want to get those a little faster. The rest of your upgrades would come from other events when they come around so things to look for in the future, as an example windtamers shoes are my personal favorite for Beo.
